title: VIX futures & options March expiration (SOQ settlement) — settles on FOMC decision morning
source: EST: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 536,802 bytes) and parsed row-by-row by this session: the table carries a live contract row rendered `"VX/H7", " - ", "2027-03-17"` with real daily settlement prices against it (20.7295, 20.8641), i.e. Cboe is already listing and settling the March-2027 VIX future on this date. Deterministic cross-check, which reproduces on EVERY VX/VXM row the page carries from 2026-09 through 2027-04: the expiration is the Wednesday exactly 30 days before the following month's third-Friday SPX expiration (09-16 -> 10-16, 10-21 -> 11-20, 11-18 -> 12-18, 12-16 -> 2027-01-15, 01-20 -> 02-19, 02-17 -> 03-19, and here 2027-03-17 -> 2027-04-16). Filed estimate, NOT confirmed, purely because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the evidence is the same OCC:-grade class that promoted the sibling vix-expiration-2026-09-16, so this entry is confirm-ready at its own initial research
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2027-03-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and it is an exact structural rhyme with the September 2026 corridor this repo already researched. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW expiration exactly 30 days out — here the 2027-04-16 series, NOT the 2027-03-19 witching — and the expiring contract stops trading 09:00 ET, roughly five hours BEFORE the 14:00 ET FOMC decision that same day (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate, the first SEP of 2027). Two consequences the witching ledger leans on. (1) FOMC-day volatility exposure cannot live in the expiring VIX contract, so the vol complex's own hedges leave the board on the MORNING of the decision, two sessions before the equity witching. (2) The front VIX future into the 2027-03-19 witching is therefore the APRIL contract (VX/J7, expiry 2027-04-21 on the same fetched page), which references an expiration a month past the witching — so the vol curve's front end is not the witching's own gamma. Net: 'the gamma rolls off Friday' understates how early the cushion starts leaving, exactly as the 2026-09-16 sibling recorded. Impact LOW: it widens caution about the 03-17 -> 03-19 corridor, supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 03-17 opening auction), and licenses nothing.
